en: Yesterday: boil an egg for exactly nine minutes, with only a four minute and a seven minute sand timer.
Here is the trick. Start both timers when the egg goes in.
At four minutes, the small timer runs out. Flip it.
At seven minutes, the big timer runs out. Flip it too.
At eight minutes, the small timer runs out again. Now flip the big one. It has one minute of sand left.
When it runs out, that is exactly nine minutes.
Person one must take a wolf, a goat, and a cabbage across a river.
The rowing boat is very small. It holds Person one, and only one more thing.
Left alone, the wolf will eat the goat. And the goat will eat the cabbage.
How does Person one get all three across safely?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
